div.head: Ine Rb 31
div.ab: LXXV. Be þon ðe mon wif bycge, ⁊ ðonne sio gift tostonde.
LXXV. Be ðon þe mon wíf byccge, ⁊ þonne sio gift tostande.
Si quis feminam emat et pretium retineat.
LXXV Be ðon þe mon wíf bycgge, þonne sio gift tostande.
Be þam þe man wif bycge, seo gift wiðstande
Concerning if a man makes a contract for a wife, and then the gift [marriage] is not forthcoming
Concerning he who makes a contract for a wife, and the gift [marriage] is withheld
Darüber, dass jemand eine Frau [zur Ehe] kauft, und nachher die Trauung unterbleibt.
Concerning someone buying a woman [in marriage], and the marriage afterwards not taking place.
